* '''Assembly:''' Vigilance
* '''Raised By:''' Bryce the Hare
* '''Judgement:''' Vigilance demands we seek to eliminate threats before they strike and disregard those that choose not to take action. Cultists of Agramant mock and deride the Empire's treatment of cannibalism, they feel empowered to act without fear because we continue to endorse it. The Vigilance Assembly urges the Senate to make cannibalism illegal, and let the virtue of its practitioners be challenged.
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (279-0)
* '''Notes:''' References the ongoing machinations of [[Agramant]]

===Judgement 170===
* '''Assembly:''' General
* '''Raised By:''' Aristeia Starchaser
* '''Judgement:''' The stars, their tulpas, and associated cultists have been, over the past two years, increasingly able to affect the souls of those who interact with the stars - willingly or not. I urge all priests to be like starlight and use the ceremony of insight to check the souls of those who might have been affected by star interactions. The Wanderer has taken souls, preventing them from entering the Labyrinth. An Urizen soul has had a strength five spirit on it following a transformation involving the Lock and the Door combined. And this summit, Claw cultists have been able to leave the Mark of the Claw on those they interacted with. Be Vigilant astronomancers. Include your priests as you will need them now.
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (858-0)
* '''Notes:''' A discussion of the magical tradition of [[Astronomancy]], and potential spiritual threats related to it.

===Judgement 172===
* '''Assembly:''' Urizen
* '''Raised By:''' Galene Netherwatch
* '''Judgement:''' People of Redoubt, prepare for storms. The cultists of Siakha bring blood and lightning; we must hold against them. Secure your spires, citadels, and temples. If you need to leave, your fellows in Zenith, Morrow, and Spiral. Be Vigilant, be Proud, be Loyal.
* '''Outcome:''' {{GM}} (230-0)
* '''Notes:''' References the storms unleashed by the Children of Wrecks on [[Redoubt]], as alluded to in the '''[[387YE_Spring_Equinox_interlude#Foam_and_Floods_(Redoubt)|Spring Equinox 387YE]]''' interlude

===Judgement 173===
* '''Assembly:''' Freeborn
* '''Raised By:''' Asier i Elia i Guerra
* '''Judgement:''' Freeborn of Kahraman and Segura, the Lasambrians are at our borders: all knowledge is incomplete and yet we must act, ready to respond to what may be. Be prepared, be vigilant, cleave to your Courage and take strength from the Loyalty that binds us as a people, and indeed an Empire, together!
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (64-0)
* '''Notes:''' References the Lasambrians, who have engaged in ongoing treaty negotiations with the Empire, as most recently discussed in the '''[[So far so fast]]''' wind of fortune

===Judgement 178===
* '''Assembly:''' Varushkan
* '''Raised By:''' Slavomira Koslov
* '''Judgement:''' We call to action priests to assist in clearing the haunted Spires of Solokha in Axos with the aims of aiding our ally and fostering relations in virtue.
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (124-0)
* '''Notes:''' References the efforts to cleanse the ruins of Solokha, as discussed in the '''[[It_never_happened#Cleansing_the_Ruins|It never happened]]''' wind of fortune. As the mandate - [[#Judgement_25|Judgement 25]] - did not achieve a greater majority, it is not possible for Varushkan congregation owners to contribute towards cleansing the ruins directly.

===Judgement 181===
* '''Assembly:''' Marcher
* '''Raised By:''' Creighton Blackewater
* '''Judgement:''' We, the Marcher Assembly, exalt the virtue of Gerraint Black, Guardian of the Prosperity of Afal. He courageously stood against overwhelming numbers of Agramant cultists, protected the Copse of the Bone Birch regio, and saved the Ashill militia. The devastating strength of his Summer mastery consumed both him and the attackers in a ball of Summer fire, leaving only his staff behind. Gerraint Black we exalt thee.
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (86-0)

===Judgement 182===
* '''Assembly:''' Varushkan
* '''Raised By:''' Velko Perunovich Razoradze
* '''Judgement:''' After a warning from Wintermark that animals are attacking citizens and that this madness may spread to Varushka, we call upon the inspiration of Zoria to use our wisdom to ask what the right question is and whether this has happened before.
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (106-0)
* '''Notes:''' References the ongoing peculiarity of beasts attacking, as discussed in the '''[[Patterns_of_fairytales#Animal_Magic?|Patterns of fairytales]]''' wind of fortune

===Judgement 184===
* '''Assembly:''' Marcher
* '''Raised By:''' Kennett the Mummer
* '''Judgement:''' Hue and cry! Hue and cry! There is a cult at large across the Empire dedicated to the constellation of the Claw. Their actions rouse animals to attack, so watch your livestock. Their symbol is claw marks and blood drops. Please refer developments in this case to Duncan of Ashill. Kennett is busy with other important matters.
* '''Outcome:''' {{GM}} (106-0)
* '''Notes:''' Assigns the ongoing peculiarity of beasts attacking, as discussed in the '''[[Patterns_of_fairytales#Animal_Magic?|Patterns of fairytales]]''' wind of fortune, to a cult of [[the Claw]]

===Judgement 189===
* '''Assembly:''' Highborn
* '''Raised By:''' Kish of the Flame Beneath the Earth
* '''Judgement:''' Vigilance demands we be alert to all dangers; within and without. The Archmage of Spring has reported that Siakha will attack Necropolis next season. In Vigilance we must mobilise to defend our land and protect our people from the Children of Wrecks. Do not fear to act; only be ashamed by inaction.
* '''Outcome:''' {{GM}} (506-0)
* '''Notes:''' Raises a warning that the Children of Wrecks will attack [[Necropolis]]

===Judgement 190===
* '''Assembly:''' Freeborn
* '''Raised By:''' Hembeneth i Guerra
* '''Judgement:''' The Brass Coast National Assembly believe our senatorial elections could be made more prosperous if they were adjusted to ensure that all proffered bids were considered spent by the nation and unreturnable. The intended effect of this would be; that more people would find the elections, and the pursuit of their ambitions, more accessible and the full proceeds of the elections to bolster the coast.
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (74-8)
* '''Notes:''' Currently, only the winning bids in the [[The_Brass_Coast_leadership#Leading_a_territory|elections]] for Freeborn Senators are collected and passed into the care of [[Brass Coast egregore|Dust, Flame, and Glass]]

===Judgement 191===
* '''Assembly:''' League
* '''Raised By:''' Lia Adelaar
* '''Judgement:''' Road tolls simply and cleverly support Navarr Ambitions against the vallorn. Our League Pride calls us to follow - through on our great roads. Our Prosperity leads us to call our sister nations to join us or find contributions of equivalent magnitude.
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (112-0)
* '''Notes:''' References the recent suggestion of applying tolls to various roads across the Empire, as discussed in the '''[[The_war_of_thorns_and_flowers#For_Whom_The_Road_Tolls|The war of thorns and flowers]]''' wind of fortune

===Judgement 192===
* '''Assembly:''' League
* '''Raised By:''' Tongs Brossa de Tassato Regario
* '''Judgement:''' Sarvos be alert! <u>Maurizia Spada di Sarvos</u> is a traitor allied with the <u>Children of Wrecks</u>. She has plans to <u>raid and plunder</u> Sarvos. Our Ambition for the strength of Sarvos demands that you protect your city!!!
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (106-0)
* '''Notes:''' ''Maurizia Spada di Sarvos'' is one of the known traitors who joined the Children of Wrecks and survived the Battle of Visten Head, as discussed in the '''[[On_southern_sands#Objective:_Eliminate_the_traitors|On southern sands]]'''

===Judgement 194===
* '''Assembly:''' Vigilance
* '''Raised By:''' Anatloij Paukov Zorkin
* '''Judgement:''' Citizens of the northwest, the north, and the west. The constellation of the Claw is inciting wild animals to unnatural violence. Be vigilant! Do not wander thoughtlessly through natural landscapes you have previously known to be safe.
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (228-0)
* '''Notes:''' References the ongoing peculiarity of beasts attacking, as discussed in the '''[[Patterns_of_fairytales#Animal_Magic?|Patterns of fairytales]]''' wind of fortune

===Judgement 196===
* '''Assembly:''' Nine
* '''Raised By:''' Constanza i Kalamar i Guerra
* '''Judgement:''' The Council of Nine directs the Silent Bell to investigate Imperial farms, forests, or mana sites touched by the malign influence of Yaw'nagrah and to report on the Imperial citizens who have taken these illegal boons in the following nations: Marches, Varushka, Urizen, and Navarr
* '''Outcome:''' {{GM}} (9-0)

===Judgement 197===

* '''Raised By:''' Viviane Barossa

In penance for my lack of vigilance, as my Assembly requires and requests, I commit to supporting the call to guard and watch the priests who exorcise Solokha. I do this with my hands in the fire. I pay the price for my ambition.
* '''Outcome:''' {{GM}} (9-0)
* '''Notes:''' References the ongoing crisis of faith around cardinals swearing an oath to carry an item hallowed with an aura of [[Malign_spiritual_presences#Peace|Peace]], as discussed in the '''[[A little understanding]]''' wind of fortune

===Judgement 199===
* '''Assembly:''' League

* '''Judgement:''' Citizens of the League! Two hundred and fifty years have passed since Holberg joined the Empire - let us celebrate! We announce a grand celebration in Holberg, culminating in a parade displaying many artefacts of history loaned by the Printers' Guild Museum of Wonders, including the Ring of Holberg.
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (220-0)

===Judgement 200===
* '''Assembly:''' Navarr
* '''Raised By:''' Sian Eternal
* '''Judgement:''' <u>Citizens be alert!</u> The traitor Ioan Bloodstride is allied with the children of wrecks, and will be coming to wreck and plunder our homes. Protect our people! Be vigilant against this threat!
* '''Outcome:''' {{GM}} (300-0)
* '''Notes:''' ''Ioan Bloodstride'' is one of the known traitors who joined the Children of Wrecks and survived the Battle of Visten Head, as discussed in the '''[[On_southern_sands#Objective:_Eliminate_the_traitors|On southern sands]]'''

===Judgement 201===
* '''Assembly:''' Nine
* '''Raised By:''' Vesna Borkovna Prochnost
* '''Judgement:''' The Grand Inspiration of the Way remains the greatest opportunity to spread the Way of Virtue beyond our borders, by inspiring pilgrims from all over the world. The Assembly of Nine applauds the efforts of those who have contributed so far, and encourages further commitment wherever possible. The Way uplifts us all. Let us uplift the Way.
* '''Outcome:''' {{GM}} (6-0)
* '''Notes:''' References the ongoing discussion around the place of the [[Construct Grand Inspiration of the Way|Grand Inspiration of the Way]], as discussed in the '''[[Pride_and_paragons#The_Grand_Inspiration|Pride and paragons]]''' wind of fortune

===Judgement 202===
* '''Assembly:''' Nine
* '''Raised By:''' Silas of the Cenotaph
* '''Judgement:''' I, Silas of the Cenotaph, in according to my oath to the Wisdom Assembly, with <u>support</u> from my Assembly carried a false hallowing to Peace. Due to this we now know Peace is not Apathy, in the defence of this our Way we can now, by asking the right question, shore up our defence.
* '''Outcome:''' {{GM}} (6-0)
* '''Notes:''' References the ongoing crisis of faith around cardinals swearing an oath to carry an item hallowed with an aura of [[Malign_spiritual_presences#Peace|Peace]], as discussed in the '''[[A little understanding]]''' wind of fortune

===Judgement 203===
* '''Assembly:''' Vigilance
* '''Raised By:''' Felix Saltspire
* '''Judgement:''' Vigilance demands we be alert to all dangers; within and without. The Archmage of Spring has reported that Siakha will attack Necropolis next season. In Vigilance we must mobilise to defend our land and protect our people from the Children of Wrecks.
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (178-0)
* '''Notes:''' Raises a warning that the Children of Wrecks will attack [[Necropolis]]

===Judgement 204===
* '''Assembly:''' Imperial Orc
* '''Raised By:''' Gralka
* '''Judgement:''' Bleak was the battle that fought through the valley as a vivid black sunset cast the plateau's shadow over us all. So many lost, that have remained silent, still, dead. Names lost in the malaise of Solen's Doubt and war. To who you would build in this place and wipe clean wars blood face. We the Imperial Orc National Assembly ask that you the builders let us send our bonetenders to reclaim the remains of our fallen and chart their names or marker sin the bricks of the dam.
* '''Outcome:''' {{GM}} (56-0)
* '''Notes:''' Relates to the plan to establish a dam in [[Spiral]], as discussed in the '''[[Million_miles_of_water#The_Way_Less_Taken|Million miles of water]]''' wind of fortune

===Judgement 206===
* '''Assembly:''' Varushkan
* '''Raised By:''' Miroslav Temnavoda
* '''Judgement:''' Alert! The traitor Zavetta Voglanova is allied with the Children of Wrecks, and will be bringing storm and plunder to our lands. We are stronger than any traitor - we will defend our homes.
* '''Outcome:''' {{GM}} (338-0)
* '''Notes:''' '' Zavetta Voglavnova'' is one of the known traitors who joined the Children of Wrecks and survived the Battle of Visten Head, as discussed in the '''[[On_southern_sands#Objective:_Eliminate_the_traitors|On southern sands]]'''

==Mandate==
Nine [[mandate|mandates]] were presented to the assemblies during the Winter Solstice
===Judgement 20===
* '''Assembly:''' Vigilance
* '''Raised By:''' Lochias
* '''Judgement:''' Major Benson knew that the reward for a good job is more work, and his inspiration teaches us to be alert to danger before it strikes. We send Lochias of the Scarlet Guard with 25 doses of liao to urge people to learn more about the sects of Axos and the ruins of Solokha

We send Alessi of the Basilisks of the Labyrinth with 25 doses of liao to encourage Imperial priests to support the exorcists of Axos in cleansing the haunted ruin of its taint. The need to help those trapped souls to reach the Labyrinth outweighs the risks of cooperating with the blasphemous and heretical priests of Axos.
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (1384-78)

* '''Enacted:'''

===Judgement 127===

We send Ira Ashes Blaze with 25 doses of liao to watch those travelling to Solokha and make a full accounting of them so that we might uncover those who embrace wickedness.

* '''Enacted:''' 

===Judgement 171===
* '''Assembly:''' Vigilance
* '''Raised By:''' Asteria of Ocean Kite’s Roost
* '''Judgement:''' We prepare for malice, but must always thwart malice before it strikes against you. We send Asteria of Ocean Kite’s Roost with 25 liao to Astolat to urge all vigilant citizens to seek out threats and drag them into the light. Of particular note are cults of Blood on Snow
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (250-0)
* '''Enacted:'''

===Judgement 205===
* '''Assembly:''' Imperial Orc
* '''Raised By:''' Ashborn Atla
* '''Judgement:''' Our people know the worth of all things. This assembly sends Ashborn Atla with 25 doses of liao to urge the Sunstorm sept to find a way to help in Feroz. Let us show them what this help was worth to us and rebuild stronger.
* '''Outcome:''' {{GM}} 
* '''Enacted:'''
* '''Notes:''' Asks the [[Sunstorm]] sept to offer aid in [[Feroz]], rather than [[Mareave]], as detailed in the '''[[Million_miles_of_water#A_New_Qanat|Million miles of water]]''' wind of fortune. As the Icarion Qanat was not commissioned at the Winter Solstice, the Sunstorm have not set forth to help in Feroz. If the Qanat is commissioned before the end of the Autumn Equinox 387YE then the sept will travel to Feroz to provide aid to the Freeborn without needing a further mandate.

==Writ of Excommunication==
One [[Writ of Excommunication]] was presented to the assemblies during the Winter Solstice
===Judgement 7===
* '''Assembly:''' General
* '''Raised By:''' Claude Deeds
* '''Judgement:''' Archavion Wolfborn's deeds are sickening and abhorrent - he must face the Writ of Excommunication, Synod's most severe judgement. The General illegally ordered the mass murder of all Rahvin Orcs who defended their home, The Fangs. Rahvin are Foreigners, staunch enemies of the Druj: former slaves, who Courageously freed themselves. Archavion spat in Synod's face: his National Assembly voted the Rahvin should not be attacked. He claims they were a grave threat. This is a lie, and he knows it. His orders reek of False Virtues. For Fear and Hatred he urged an entire army on to vile acts in the Barrens. It is an outrage to our Faith. He has done the Druj's work for them. Synod cannot permit a liar corrupted by Fear and Hatred to order our soldiers to murder the Courageous, then call himself Vigilant to cover his tracks. Pass this Writ, stripping him of the right to bear any Imperial title. Let he who has endangered so many now be Vigilant for his own soul.
* '''Outcome:'''  {{GM}} (2270-224)

==Revocation==
Six [[revocation|revocations]] were presented to the assemblies during the Winter Solstice
===Judgement 27===
* '''Assembly:''' Dawnish
* '''Raised By:''' Earl Tegwen Berinore
* '''Judgement:''' Dawn will not stand with a general that, in our Emperor's words, turned to lawlessness because he lacked the skill to execute his vision any other way. He has hurt our nation in his weakness. The Dawnish Assembly revokes Archavion Wolfborne from General of the Gryphon's Pride for leading his army against the Rahvin, an orc sept of the Barrens, foreigners protected under and afforded the benefits of Imperial law.
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (316-20)

===Judgement 51===
* '''Assembly:''' General
* '''Raised By:''' Callista of the Dark Shard
* '''Judgement:''' Viviane Barossa de Coeurdefer, Cardinal of Ambition, willingly and knowingly took upon herself a hallowed object of the false virtue of "understanding" (also known as peace). They refuse to set this aside for a year. A cardinal is an example of Virtue to, and for, the Empire, and as such Viviane has shown themself to set a dangerous example, that we should condemn and revoke.
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (812-288)
* '''Notes:''' Viviane Barossa de Coeurdefer resigned before this judgement closed

===Judgement 67===
* '''Assembly:''' General
* '''Raised By:''' Emmeline Weaver
* '''Judgement:''' Zoran Orzel fucked up. Whether by Malice, Lies, Folly, or Carelessness, General Zoran De Orzel of Dawn insisted to the Military Council that the Druj would retreat from Therunin this season, as has been attested by multiple Generals. This information was directly in contradiction to that given to Zoran by the Imperial Seer Jorma Steelhail, who made clear to Zoran that the Druj intended to press their attack. This failure of Vigilance has cost the Empire two loyal armies, the Iron Helms and Isaella's Dance, and I call upon the General Assembly to Revoke Zoran De Orzel before he can fuck up any more campaigns.
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (1222-328)

===Judgement 120===
* '''Assembly:''' General
* '''Raised By:''' Kazimir Syrota Molchan
* '''Judgement:''' Captain Bernard Dugdale needs to be removed as Imperial Spymaster. Evidence should be presented rather than baseless accusations made. Produce the evidence, step down, or be removed.
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (1162-125)

===Judgement 152===
* '''Assembly:''' Navarr
* '''Raised By:''' Isaellla Dancewalker
* '''Judgement:''' Rhisiart Dancewalker has served our nation for many years. Now it is his time to find a new place in the Dance. By his own admission his oaths are in conflict and his Loyalties are divided, weighing on his soul. The burden of leadership is one we as Navarr gift to our chosen. We choose who we follow. Now, for his sake, out of Loyalty and love, we must choose not to follow Rhisiart and free him. Let the black Thorns find a new General, and him virtue anew.
* '''Outcome:''' Not Upheld (136-172)

===Judgement 180===
* '''Assembly:''' Imperial Orc
* '''Raised By:''' Skywise Tulva
* '''Judgement:''' We revoke MemoryKeeper Ikhan's position as Open Hand of the Ancestors. This title was appointed without the input of the majority of our Assembly. Let us correct this.
* '''Outcome:''' {{GM}} (48-0)
* '''Notes:''' This judgement has been interpreted as revoking MemoryKeeper Ikahn from the title of [[Guide to the Lost]]

==Sanction==
Nineteen [[sanction|sanctions]] were presented to the assemblies during the Winter Solstice
===Judgement 22===
* '''Assembly:''' General
* '''Raised By:''' Leliel, Daughter of Armisael
* '''Judgement - Penance:''' Luke's past life vision, and the associated experimental theology tied to it has been investigated. It has been determined that the strong Loyalty dedication that spontaneously manifested was more closely connected to the experiment. This was exacerbated by Luke's then-inexperience in Virtue. It would be best for Luke if this dedication was removed, and he served the following penance; to serve in each of the Virtue Assemblies for a season, until he can express on Virtue as his own.
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (178-64)  
* '''Notes:''' Whilst such a penance might be willingly taken on by Luke, there is no legal requirement for him to do so.

===Judgement 69===
* '''Assembly:''' Urizen
* '''Raised By:''' Lochias
* '''Judgement - Vindication:''' Following inquisition, this Assembly is satisfied that Iosef of Phoenix Reach has demonstrated four of the signs of the Exemplar: Legacy, Pilgrimage, Benevolence, Inspiration. The other signs are either Unproven or Unprovable at the current time. It is therefore a matter for the Virtue Assemblies to Recognise his achievements. (This judgement is an escalation of Judgement 168 at the Autumn Equinox 386. Notes from that Inquisition are available on request.)
* '''Outcome:''' {{GM}} (194-58)

===Judgement 79===
* '''Assembly:''' Wisdom
* '''Raised By:''' Kalina Jadwigowna Piosnkowa Prochnost
* '''Judgement - Vindication:''' Bakar: Your wisdom in choosing property over people with regards to the flooding of Madruga was called into question. You recognise you could have done more to seek out the Archmages of Night and Spring. Equally, you acted on the information you had to hand, having discussed it at length with your nation. You acknowledge you have more to learn. Given the endorsement of Conclave - I vindicate you.
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (166-0)

===Judgement 81===
* '''Assembly:''' Wisdom
* '''Raised By:''' Kalina Jadwigowna Piosnkowa Prochnost
* '''Judgement - Vindication:''' You stand accused of Heresy, You stand accused of Blasphemy. You stand accused of being a corruption at the heart of the Synod. Silas of the Cenotaph - I vindicate you. You act in purest Wisdom. You believe yourself to be the only one who should be burdened with this responsibility - like a general forges the path to arm the Synod with knowledge. The lantern burns bright in you. You willingly lay your head upon the block - handing the sword to those around you. You are no fool, afraid of consequences. You will learn, and through your education you will enrich us all. Misstep and  I will send your spirit to the labyrinth myself.
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (148-0)

===Judgement 94===
* '''Assembly:''' Wintermark
* '''Raised By:''' Eevi of the Gadrai
* '''Judgement - Penance:''' Thane Elgar Angusson's Inquisition revealed that while he demonstrates Loyalty and Prosperity to his hall, he has been careless with his words and actions. He has not upheld sworn agreements to meet with other halls and fight alongside them. He lacked Vigilance, neglecting to forge bonds with priests who could provide guidance. As penance, I charge Elgar with the following: 1) forge bonds with priests, one of Loyalty and one of Vigilance and seek guidance to deepen his understanding and application of the virtues 2) Tell the Wintermark Captains how they can make agreements with Kraken's Vanguard to fight alongside them to avoid future misunderstandings. I will check with him at the Summer Solstice to see what he has learnt.
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (166-0)

===Judgement 103===
* '''Assembly:''' Wintermark
* '''Raised By:''' Warsmith the Iron Way
* '''Judgement - Castigation:''' Lodwick Hardin sent his soldiers to kill Rahvin and steal their mine. Not only did he show no virtue in this action, acting in fear and against Prosperity, but he showed very little understanding of the Virtues throughout the inquisition. There is no penance I could offer this man to help him beside going to the academy for a few years. It is time for the labyrinth to test his soul. May his next life be more virtuous. That won't be hard.
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (90-0)

===Judgement 116===
* '''Assembly:''' Freeborn
* '''Raised By:''' Azir i Shartha
* '''Judgement - Penance:''' At the Autumn Equinox I inquisited Velasco i Guerra regarding the Asavea vote. I heard a tale of a new senator, who had insufficient time to consider, falling back on his lengthy experience as a general. There was a wisdom there - although a lack of understanding of the Way more generally. As is so often the case between the houses of state, I charge Velasco to speak to his priests more. I understand this is already his intention.
* '''Outcome:''' {{GM}} (98-10)

===Judgement 123===
* '''Assembly:''' The Way
* '''Raised By:''' Maximillian
* '''Judgement - Penance:''' Following inquisition I do not hold that the actions of INISKA ASHWOOD rise to the crimes of Blasphemy or Heresy. That their acceptance of the Hallowed Aura of the False Virtue of Peace was motivated not by an intent to denigrate the Way, but a Wise desire for deeper understanding of the formation of the Way and a Loyal push to improve the Empire. The failing was in not making those Virtuous Reasons clear as such I task Iniska to create and distribute a clear and in-depth publication outlining their reasoning for taking the Aura and an idea of what they have and could learn.
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (94-46)

===Judgement 124===
* '''Assembly:''' Dawnish
* '''Raised By:''' Aster Aceae of House du Froste
* '''Judgement - Vindication:''' Last summit I carried out an inquisition of Lady Aisla Tamerlain at the behest of the late Lady Cecelia de Gauvin. The lady Aisla has time and again shared the tales of quieter courage in our nation, tales of love and glory that would have otherwise gone untold. In her own words "Art is as keen a weapon in our arsenal as any other" and her contributions to the glorious Richilde festival of the arts and her tenure as Voice of the Twin Roses have been testament to this. I move to vindicate Lady Ailsa for the virtuous work she has done for this nation and the Empire as a whole as it deserves to be recognised.
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (184-0)

===Judgement 132===
* '''Assembly:''' Ambition
* '''Raised By:''' Lenarius Ankarien
* '''Judgement - Penance:''' The assembly has heard Viviane's inquisition and her reasoning. While her original intentions in taking the hallow were not heretical, there were clear and catastrophic failures of vigilance. As penance she will: Make a statement in the Assembly of Nine denouncing "Peace". Join the vigilance assembly in ensuring the virtue of Imperial priests travelling to Axou. Step down as Cardinal of Ambition.
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (214-16)

===Judgement 146===
* '''Assembly:''' Highborn
* '''Raised By:''' Syene
* '''Judgement - Vindication:''' Following the inquisition of General Sychar of Ebon's Hall, the inquisitee has been found vindicated of fault on the events during the battle at the Autumn Equinox 386YE
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (410-14)

===Judgement 147===
* '''Assembly:''' Highborn
* '''Raised By:''' Neri
* '''Judgement - Vindication:''' After the inquisition of Lex of Ebon's Hall, Lex has been found to be vindicated for his actions at the last summit
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (430-38)

===Judgement 177===
* '''Assembly:''' Varushkan
* '''Raised By:''' Gallows Koslov
* '''Judgement - Vindication:''' The Priests of the Grimhold Guard recognise the virtuous actions of Kazimir. Through his Loyalty and Prosperity he saved many virtuous souls.
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (118-0)

===Judgement 179===
* '''Assembly:''' General
* '''Raised By:''' Vasili, Pride of Ossium
* '''Judgement - Vindication:''' Following Inquisition of Empress Vesna, I find the Empress' goals, actions, and spirit to be virtuous. Their dedication to the prosperity and security of the Empire are to be lauded. Vesna has been marked with the Testimony "Prosperity's Hearth".
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (884-90)
* '''Notes:''' This judgement was marked as being an Exaltation. As that motion has yet to pass through the full scrutiny of Constitutional Court this judgement is considered to be vindication for now.

===Judgement 183===
* '''Assembly:''' Prosperity
* '''Raised By:''' Darian Numbers
* '''Judgement - Vindication:''' During an Inquisition that both challenged Laughlan and his views of Prosperity and forced me to consider and grow my own understanding of Prosperity I found the following actions particularly prosperous:. His focus on spreading peoples understanding of trade and giving them confidence to go further on their own. His focus on spending not for self-promotion but to raise up the Prosperity across as much of the Empire as possible. His clarity that he enjoys the reward of his work and enjoying the virtue of his actions. If I could have a judgement of Escalation at this time I would have done. I urge Laughlan to further pursue his understanding of Prosperity to further his own virtue.
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (162-0)

===Judgement 186===
* '''Assembly:''' Courage
* '''Raised By:''' Maarit Suvidottir
* '''Judgement - Vindication:''' I have followed up my previous inquisition of Rhisiart Dancewalker (Winter 385) where we discussed him reapplying himself to the Synod. He has done so every season for the past year and was able to talk of the virtue of his judgements and behaviour. His friends spoke highly of how he had inspired their virtue, the only questions remains about if Loyalty or Courage will have his dedication, but that is for him in the future.
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (54-0)

===Judgement 187===
* '''Assembly:''' Wintermark
* '''Raised By:''' Maarit Suvidottir
* '''Judgement - Penance:''' I inquisited Urvakki about their skein and virtue earlier today. They still consider themselves frayed. We have talked of how they see themselves mending their skein including questions of Vigilance, Wisdom, and reflecting on choices. The Mark continues to support them and we will not abandon them, we build each other up.
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (66-0)

===Judgement 188===
* '''Assembly:''' Highborn
* '''Raised By:''' Ilai
* '''Judgement - Vindication:''' Following the inquisition of Pariah of the Red Suns, he has been found to be <u>vindicated</u> for his actions at the last summit.
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (318-0)

===Judgement 195===
* '''Assembly:''' Highborn
* '''Raised By:''' Nekoda of the Shattered Tower
* '''Judgement - Penance:''' In conclusion of his inquisition, Exarch Mattheas of the Silent Tide acknowledged that the split in Highguard forces in battle at the Autumn Summit of 386 was due to the feud between his chapter and the Sentinel's Tower. For his part in allowing this feud to fester rather than seeking resolution, I give a Penance of taking concrete steps before the next Day of the Dead to close this rift to the point where cooperation is possible. Loyalty cannot be compelled, but moving past these conflicts allows us all to stand greater in Virtue.
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (258-138)

===Judgement 198===
* '''Assembly:''' Nine
* '''Raised By:''' Gaelen Embercast
* '''Judgement - Castigation:''' Pickers Goldleaf has died after admitting on the Senate floor to active treason with the Grendel. Selling army orders and Imperial rituals. Before he died he admitted to spreading falsehoods about the empress in order to undermine the Imperial state and encourage her execution to install himself as throne. In his capacity as Imperial Spymaster Bernard 'Whitecap' Dugdale perpetuated these falsehoods. Whether he is involved in this treason is a matter for the magistrates. The Assembly of Nine believes that this demonstrates a profound lack of vigilance and wisdom to the detriment of the Empire.
* '''Outcome:''' {{GM}} (7-0)
* '''Notes:''' It is unclear which of Pickers Goldleaf and Bernard 'Whitecap' Dugdale is being [[Sanction#Castigation|castigated]] with this judgement.

==Recognition==
Four [[recognition|recognitions]] was presented to the assemblies during the Winter Solstice

===Judgement 4===
* '''Assembly:''' General
* '''Raised By:''' Jared of the Sentinel's Tower
* '''Judgement:''' We Recognise Ravadi Founder's Dance as an exemplar of Vigilance. ''Pilgrimage'' - They left Dawn to join the Founder's Dance Striding in Navarr, and walked the original path of the Exemplars Navarr and Thorn when the Trods were first created, guarding the world against the vallorn threat with every step. ''Legacy'' - As Champion of Vigilance they were a driving force to forge mere titles into a cohesive organisation worthy to Inspire the Empire, several other Champions have pointed to this as Ravadi's Legacy. ''Benevolence'' - In sacrificing their dreams for a year to hunt down Bawn-Watch the Champion's Shield they would never hold, on behalf of every Champion that would follow after. ''Inspiration'' - Their Inspirational Vigilance was recognised by the Assembly in their appointment to Champion, and many priests of Vigilance will attest to this and their work that followed, seek us out.
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (1126-219)

===Judgement 5===
* '''Assembly:''' General
* '''Raised By:''' Jedediah Boon
* '''Judgement:''' We recognise the leaders of the Ore Hills rebellion of 326YE; Esme Hooper, Mary Digger, Ezekial "Zeke" Boon, Henry Killinghall, Maggie John, and Tom John as Exemplars of Pride. ''Pilgrimage:'' Zeke Boon with Maggie and Tom John undertook pilgrimage to Bastion in 318YE. ''Salvation:'' They turned the miners away from descent into Hatred, uplifting them to Prideful action, saving their lives and souls. ''Benevolence:'' They acted to prevent the starvation of the miners of Ore Hills, leading the Rebellion to take the supplies needed. ''Legacy:'' The songs of the Ore Hills, the Scythe of Shepherds, and Mary Digger's execution site remain; a Great Work is being constructed to follow. ''Inspiration:'' They inspired the Ore Hills Rebellion itself; in death their deeds Inspired the rising of the Ore Hills miners to resist the Jotun occupation of 386YE. Plan. Arm. Enchant. Resist. Exalt. Remember.
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (1053-808)

===Judgement 12===
* '''Assembly:''' Loyalty
* '''Raised By:''' Dagon of the Shattered Tower
* '''Judgement:''' We recognise Alberto Acciai, Martyr of Marilen, as an Exemplar of Loyalty, with the following signs: ''Benevolence:'' Inspired by his cousin Amika, Alberto led a rebellion of slaves in the mines surrounding Marilen. Alberto was a vintner, and freed these slaves solely in pursuit of Virtue rather than riches. ''Inspiration:'' After the rebellion, Alberto led the liberated miners to the city of Marilen, where they took over the city and slew its rulers, resolving to destroy the two coming armies of the Plenum in Virtue. ''Salvation:'' In freeing these slaves, Albero was able to teach them and the people of Marilen the Way of Virtue and the use of liao, spreading our shared faith across the oppressed of the Archipelago. ''Legacy:'' Based on correspondence with Rafael Barossa d'Apulian, we know that Alberto could have fled. Instead, out of Loyalty to those he had freed, he gave his life to ignite Virtue across Asavea.
* '''Outcome:''' {{GM}} (404-60)

===Judgement 87===
* '''Assembly:''' Pride
* '''Raised By:''' Edward Watcher
* '''Judgement:''' We recognise Eleanor Novarion, the Lady of the Proffered Hand, as an Exemplar of Pride. Once a slave, she dedicated her life following her freedom and recovery to helping others who had suffered the same, demonstrating her ''Benevolence''. Her work served as ''Inspiration'' to others, resulting in the creation of the Proffered Hand Network across the Empire. She was pivotal in securing the ''Salvation'' of the Free Folk of Asavea, reconciling their beliefs with the Way, an event marked by a miraculous aura of Pride. In her final months, she undertook ''Pilgrimage'' to Bastion, where she summarised her life with these words, a lesson to be shared across the Empire: "The greatest threat to Pride is shame. The greatest weapon against shame is Compassion."
* '''Outcome:''' {{GM}} (243-10)

==Rewarding==
Four [[rewarding|rewardings]] were presented to the assemblies during the Winter Solstice
===Judgement 6===
* '''Assembly:''' General
* '''Raised By:''' Jonah Yakovitch
* '''Judgement:''' Prince Bishop Yakovitch, Priest of Vigilance, seeks the support of the General Assembly to reward the exemplary Pride of Lorenzo Le Volpe. He, who took his vast wealth and as an example to us all, performed numerous acts of benevolence. Via 21 great works he built across the Empire, he continues to raise up the wealth, mana, and spiritual guidance of citizens in every nation. Let us inspire citizens to follow in his footsteps with this rewarding. In all Lorenzo did, he left the blood red mark of the Butchers Guild, therefore, I call the Synod to recognise and reward Lorenzo's pride by supporting the creation of the Blood Red Counting Houses with a reward of 38 thrones to demonstrate our support for these legacies. The Blood Red Counting Houses will allow virtuous citizens to echo Lorenzo's benevolence and donate to the virtue fund.
* '''Outcome:''' Not Upheld (344-632)

===Judgement 16===
* '''Assembly:''' General
* '''Raised By:''' Aspar
* '''Judgement:''' With the blessing of the Assembly of Nine* I request 62 thrones to be disbursed to the Imperial treasury to offset income lost to Asavean piracy. Consequences are the price of Ambition, we are willing to pay the cost. *Judgement 212, Autumn 386YE
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (1000-244) 
* '''Notes:''' A partial provision was made for payment, amounting to 55 thrones, 1 crown, and 16 rings

===Judgement 47===
* '''Assembly:''' General
* '''Raised By:''' Halwyn Splitroot
* '''Judgement:''' Idwyn Splitroot is the voice of Navarr and an inspiration of Pride for all who attend Navarr songs and stories. Let us recognise her service and help her rebuild First Voice Glade School, which was desecrated by the foul ''scions'' of Cold Sun, with the reward of 20 thrones (repeated from Autumn due to lack of funds).
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (519-434) 
* '''Notes:''' While this judgement was upheld, there were no funds available.

===Judgement 139===
* '''Assembly:''' General
* '''Raised By:''' Eddard Warmhearth 
* '''Judgement:''' I seek your aid in the rewarding of one Odette Baudelaire of house Du Letharia of the Lavender Court. During the last event she not only with great wisdom and ambition took up the role of acting earl but saved a member of the lavender lance from a cowardly act of assassination with poison! I, Eddard Warmheath of Dawn and of the Prosperity Assembly, call for the general assembly to reward her with 60 crowns from the virtue fund!
* '''Outcome:''' Upheld (402-396) 
* '''Notes:''' A partial provision was made for payment, amounting to 2 thrones, 5 crowns, and 1 ring

==Special Considerations==
The following considerations should be borne in mind when bringing judgements before the Imperial Synod during the Winter Solstice.
<table class='wikitable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed sortable'><tr><td style="background-color: LightBlue;">'''Assembly'''</td><td style="background-color: LightBlue;">'''Consideration'''</td><td style="background-color: LightBlue;">'''Link'''</td><td style="background-color: LightBlue;">'''Duration'''</td></tr>
<tr><td>All Assemblies</td><td>Statements that prioritise the greater good over personal loyalties are less effective.</td><td>[[Cardinal_of_Loyalty#Additional_Powers_-_The_Eyes_of_Loyalty|Eyes of Loyalty]]</td><td>Ongoing</td>
<tr><td>All Assemblies</td><td>Statements that try to compel Loyalty will fail.</td><td>[[Cardinal_of_Loyalty#Additional_Powers_-_The_Eyes_of_Loyalty|Eyes of Loyalty]]</td><td>Ongoing</td>
<tr><td>All Assemblies</td><td>Revocations and Excommunications for disloyalty to the nation or Empire risk causing dissent.</td><td>[[Cardinal_of_Loyalty#Additional_Powers_-_The_Eyes_of_Loyalty|Eyes of Loyalty]]</td><td>Ongoing</td>
<tr><td>All Assemblies</td><td>Any mandate that does not pass with a greater majority will have limited or no effect on Urizen or Varushka. It is not impossible that a mandate might lead to a response in one of the two nations, but it won't lead to any immediate consequences for the people of the nation. </td><td>[[Hard_and_suspecting#The_Urizen_Assembly|Urizen Link]]<br>[[Hard_and_suspecting#The_Varushkan_Assembly|Varushka Link]]</td><td>Ongoing</td>
<tr><td>All Assemblies</td><td>Statements that stress the need to follow Imperial law rather than virtue will be unlikely to lead to a mandate.</td><td>[[Knocking_on_every_door#A_Paper_Shield|Knocking on every door]]</td><td>Ongoing</td>
<tr><td>League Assembly</td><td>No statement of principle raised by the League Assembly that calls on citizens to support a different cause will have an effect.</td><td>[[The war of thorns and flowers#The League|The war of thorns and flowers]]</td><td>Until Spring 388YE</td>
<tr><td>Varushkan Assembly</td><td>No statement of principle raised by the Varushkan Assembly that calls on citizens to support a different cause will have an effect.</td><td>[[The war of thorns and flowers#Varushka|The war of thorns and flowers]]</td><td>Until Spring 388YE</td>
</table>

==Doses of True Liao==

Five doses of [[Liao#True Liao|True Liao]] were disbursed this summit:
* One dose to Vesna Borkovna Prochnost as [[the Throne]]
* One dose in connection to the [[Lepidean Librarian|Lepidean University]] to Taddea Ginori via [[#Judgement 3|Judgement 3]]
* One dose to Asael of Reumah's Redoubt by purchase in the [[Public auction|Public Auction]]
* One dose to Maegruth "Bear" Bearonovich Strascovich by decision of the Gatekeepers
* One dose to Finna of Dawn by decision of the Gatekeepers
